sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Trimester Pro is designed with your privacy in mind. The app stores all preferences locally on your device only. We do not collect, transmit or sell personal data.

sections.title: Data We Store Locally
sections.content: The following data is stored only on your device and never sent to our servers: your pregnancy start date, language preference, week progress, symptom journal entries, contraction history, kick counter data, weight logs, and appointment notes.

sections.title: Data We Do Not Collect
sections.content: We do not collect: your name, email, location, health records, biometric data, or any identifying information. There are no analytics trackers or advertising SDKs in the app.

sections.title: Partner Sharing
sections.content: When you use the 'Share with Partner' feature, a link is generated via trimesterpro.app containing only your current week number and baby size information. No personal identifying information is included in these links.

sections.title: Notifications
sections.content: If you enable notifications, the app schedules local notifications on your device. No notification data is sent to external servers.

sections.title: Camera & Photos
sections.content: The app may request camera access for the Bump Gallery feature. Photos are stored locally on your device only.

sections.title: Future Changes
sections.content: If we add cloud sync or analytics in the future, we will clearly disclose it, obtain consent, and provide opt-out options before implementing any changes.

sections.title: Contact
